from_club_is_DERIVED.problem: the opinion NEVER names the Canadian club. It says 'Kapp's Canadian team' and 'his Canadian team'. Verified: the strings Lions, British Columbia, Vancouver, Calgary and B.C. appear ZERO times in the opinion.
from_club_is_DERIVED.basis: the opinion states 'Kapp's last Canadian contract expired after the 1966 season'. StatsCrew CFL 1966 carries Joe Kapp (slug p-kappjoe001, born March 19 1938) on CFLBC and on no other 1966 club.
from_club_is_DERIVED.reproducible: anyone with the opinion and StatsCrew's CFL 1966 rosters reaches CFLBC by the same two steps
from_club_is_DERIVED.NOT_done: the club was not supplied from general knowledge. That would be invention wearing this opinion's provenance - the failure the dataset exists to prevent.
from_club_is_DERIVED.caution: Kapp appears on BOTH CFLBC and CFLCGY in 1961, so club-per-season is not always single-valued for him. 1966 is unambiguous.
